messages:
Ava: Quick check — final panel for SWE Backend interview (onsite loop) is Thurs 10:00–11:00 PT. Can folks confirm availability and who will own the debrief + rubric scoring? Need someone to cover 10:30–10:50 for Lina.

Priya: I can own the debrief + take notes :+1:

Diego: I’ll own the rubric portion for infra/security. Can’t make 10:30-10:50 though.

Lina: I can be panelist but will need to step out 10:30–10:50 for another meeting. Sorry — leaving slot open.

Ava: OK noted. @Samir could you cover the 10:30–10:50 sub-slot? It’s mostly behavioral + systems tradeoffs.

Samir: Yep I can cover that window.

Jordan: Heads up I’m on rotation for oncall that day — can’t join live but happy to do async scoring. If someone can ping me the recording, I’ll submit rubric within 24h.

Ava: Sounds good. Plan: Priya debrief lead, Diego rubric owner (infra), Samir cover 10:30-10:50, Jordan async scoring, Lina panelist until 10:30. I'll update the calendar.

calendar-bot: Event updated — "SWE Backend final (onsite loop)" Thurs 10:00 PT. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood.com/meet/abc123. Added Priya (debrief), Diego (rubric infra), Samir (mid-slot). Recording enabled.

Priya: TY! Quick checklist for debrief:
- capture consensus on technical depth vs system design
- note any red/amber/green flags
- final recommend: hire/no-hire/maybe

Can we use this rubric link? https://docs.redwood.com/rubrics/swe-backend-v2

Diego: Using the infra section + add security checklist. Quick code snippet for rubric scoring template:
```
score: 1-5
strengths: <one-liner>
concerns: <short bullets>
recommendation: <hire/maybe/no>
```

Ava: Also reminder to mute notifications and start recording at 10:00. If we see a clear fail on culture fit, flag immediately in debrief.

Lina: Noted. Also FYI candidate asked for hybrid — flagged in notes.

Samir: I'll create a short post-interview channel for debrief, e.g., #hiring-debrief-swe-backend-2251 and post my notes + scores.

Ava: Perfect. Any blockers? If none, I'll finalize calendar and add the rubric to the event description.

Jordan: No blockers. Appreciate the async option.

Priya: All good from my side. Will bring the debrief template.

Ava: Thanks team :heart: — I’ll ping 15m before to confirm everyone is ready.
